ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast ratio; the visible surface is dominated by low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels with localized high-intensity (white/yellow) clusters at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a continuous low-intensity dark field. High-contrast, irregular geometric blobs are located at the extreme lateral margins (distal tips) of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped central depression with a clearly defined vertex separating the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes are visible along the entire continuous trailing edge, particularly pronounced near the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the central notch towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast white and yellowish pixels forming irregular rosettes on the far edges of both the left and right fluke tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive localized encrustations or parasitic accumulations resulting in high-contrast pixel clusters at the distal margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible high-velocity water runoff streams trailing from the right lobe tip and central notch.
